:::{#sol-prac-exp-mle-maximum}

Evaluated at $\hat\pmean_{ML} = \rvarbar$:

$$
\ba
\hess(\rvarbar; \vx)
&= \frac{n}{\rvarbar^2} - \frac{2n\rvarbar}{\rvarbar^3}
&& \text{(second derivative at $\pmean = \rvarbar$)}
\\
&= \frac{n}{\rvarbar^2} - \frac{2n}{\rvarbar^2}
&& \text{(cancel one factor of $\rvarbar$)}
\\
&= -\frac{n}{\rvarbar^2}
&& \text{(combine like terms)}
\ea
$$

Since $n > 0$ and $\rvarbar^2 > 0$, the second derivative is negative,
so $\hat\pmean_{ML} = \rvarbar$ is a maximum.

:::
